sentences.en: On the 12th day of the government shutdown, Chuck Schumer and Nancy Pelosi went to the White House and proposed that the
sentences.zh: 在政府停摆的第12天，查克·舒默和南希·佩洛西前往白宫，提议

sentences.en: president end the shutdown by signing democratic legislation with no wall.
sentences.zh: 总统通过签署不含边境墙拨款的民主党法案来结束停摆。

sentences.en: A couple hours after they made that proposal, we spoke to Senator Schumer about his newly emboldened approach
sentences.zh: 在他们提出该建议几个小时后，我们采访了舒默参议员，谈到了他新采取的强硬方针，

sentences.en: and how he and Pelosi plan to stick together as the era of divided government begins.
sentences.zh: 以及在分裂政府时代开启之际，他和佩洛西计划如何保持团结。

sentences.en: It's Thursday,
sentences.zh: 今天是周四，

sentences.en: January 3rd.
sentences.zh: 1月3日。

sentences.en: We're looking for a minority in the New York Schumer's office.
sentences.zh: 我们正在寻找舒默办公室里的少数党成员。

sentences.en: Okay, well first just go to the desk real quick, but it's upstairs on the second floor, so take the elevator to the second floor.
sentences.zh: 好的，先去前台问一下，不过办公室在二楼，所以坐电梯上二楼吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what are we doing on the second floor?
sentences.zh: 那我们去二楼做什么？

sentences.en: You tell me, what are we doing on the second floor?
sentences.zh: 你问我？你觉得我们去二楼做什么？

sentences.en: We're checking in with somebody?
sentences.zh: 我们要去见某个人吗？

sentences.en: Oh shit.
sentences.zh: 该死。

sentences.en: Going up.
sentences.zh: 上楼。

sentences.en: Okay, so where are we going?
sentences.zh: 好了，我们要去哪儿？

sentences.en: We're on the elevator inside the Capitol building headed to the second floor.
sentences.zh: 我们正在国会大厦的电梯里，前往二楼。

sentences.en: Second floor.
sentences.zh: 二楼。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Um, am I now working in the Schumer's office?
sentences.zh: 呃，我现在是在舒默的办公室工作吗？

sentences.en: We're from the New York Times right now?
sentences.zh: 我们现在是《纽约时报》的？

sentences.en: Senator.
sentences.zh: 参议员。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: You look a little different.
sentences.zh: 你看起来有点不一样。

sentences.en: Do you have different glasses?
sentences.zh: 你换眼镜了吗？

sentences.en: I do have different glasses.
sentences.zh: 我确实换了眼镜。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's very generous of you to notice.
sentences.zh: 你能注意到这一点，真是太细心了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In Brooklyn, we don't have fireplaces, so this is the greatest thing, and I have learned how to make a fire.
sentences.zh: 在布鲁克林，我们没有壁炉，所以这是最棒的东西，我已经学会了怎么生火。

sentences.en: That's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: Now, Paul Ryan, when he left, he gave me these.
sentences.zh: 保罗·瑞安离开时，给了我这些。

sentences.en: These are cedar fire starters.
sentences.zh: 这些是雪松木引火物。

sentences.en: They are really good and they smell good.
sentences.zh: 它们非常好用，而且闻起来很香。

sentences.en: And now we have these nice little matches.
sentences.zh: 现在我们还有这些漂亮的小火柴。

sentences.en: There's no metaphor here, right?
sentences.zh: 这没什么隐喻吧？

sentences.en: You're just starting a fire.
sentences.zh: 你只是在生火而已。

sentences.en: What I usually do with Donald Trump as president is try to put out fires.
sentences.zh: 鉴于唐纳德·特朗普担任总统，我通常做的是试图灭火。

sentences.en: We're coming, and I'm sorry it got a little delayed, as you can tell.
sentences.zh: 我们来了，抱歉耽搁了一会儿，如你所见。

sentences.en: I'm sort of busy.
sentences.zh: 我有点忙。

sentences.en: It was a busy day.
sentences.zh: 今天很忙。

sentences.en: So obviously I want to hear about this meeting that you had today.
sentences.zh: 显然，我想听听你今天开的那个会议的情况。

sentences.en: What was this meeting in theory?
sentences.zh: 理论上这个会议是关于什么的？

sentences.en: In theory, what it was supposed to be is a briefing on the border and why there needed to be more border security.
sentences.zh: 理论上，它应该是一场关于边境问题以及为何需要加强边境安全的简报会。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They've had the weight of this shutdown on their back ever since the first meeting when
sentences.zh: 自从第一次会议，我和南希成功让唐纳德·特朗普承认他为政府停摆感到自豪以来，

sentences.en: Nancy and I were able to elicit from Donald Trump that he was proud to own a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 他们就一直背负着停摆的压力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And since then, they've sort of been squirming.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们就有点坐立不安了。

sentences.en: They can't figure out what their position is.
sentences.zh: 他们搞不清楚自己的立场是什么。

sentences.en: It changes several times a day sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时一天之内变好几次。

sentences.en: And so they had to show some motion, and this was the purpose of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须表现出一些动作，这就是会议的目的。

sentences.en: But Pelosi and I are very close and have been since she came to Congress in 1986.
sentences.zh: 但我和佩洛西关系非常密切，从她1986年进入国会以来就是这样。

sentences.en: We talk five, six, seven times a day.
sentences.zh: 我们一天要通五、六、七次话。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we figured that what we wanted to do was not let them divert attention from the main issue, which is the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，我们想做的是不让他们转移对主要问题的注意力，也就是政府停摆。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And we had talked about a strategy, which was to do six bills that would reopen the government in every agency but Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过一个策略，就是通过六项法案，让除国土安全部之外的所有政府机构恢复运作。

sentences.en: There are eight that are not open.
sentences.zh: 目前有八个部门处于停摆状态。

sentences.en: So we put these six bills together in one proposal and sent it forward.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将这六项法案合并成一个提案并提交了上去。

sentences.en: And then on Homeland Security, where we have trouble agreeing, we said, let's just do that for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 至于我们在国土安全部问题上难以达成一致，我们说，那就先维持30天吧。

sentences.en: Put these six bills on the floor and challenge or ask the president to support these six bills.
sentences.zh: 把这六项法案提交到议会，挑战或要求总统支持这六项法案。

sentences.en: So the context here, just so I'm clear, is that Nancy Pelosi and the incoming class of
sentences.zh: 为了让我弄清楚背景，也就是说，南希·佩洛西和新当选的

sentences.en: freshman Democrats take power in the House tomorrow, I guess today by the time people hear this.
sentences.zh: 民主党新人明天就要在众议院掌权了，我想等人们听到这个节目时已经是今天了。

sentences.en: So the plan that the two of you are putting forward is, here's a solution.
sentences.zh: 所以你们两人提出的计划是：这是一个解决方案。

sentences.en: Here's something that's going to reopen the government.
sentences.zh: 这是一个能让政府恢复运作的方案。

sentences.en: We're providing this to you.
sentences.zh: 我们把它提供给你们。

sentences.en: What will you do in response?
sentences.zh: 你们会作何回应？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You'll get it.
sentences.zh: 你们会收到的。

sentences.en: And I said to the president, this will be good for the country, but it will be good for you and the Republican Party because, you know, the shutdown is not popular.
sentences.zh: 我对总统说，这对国家有好处，对你和共和党也有好处，因为你知道，政府停摆并不受欢迎。

sentences.en: And you justifiably, in my opinion at least, are getting blamed for it.
sentences.zh: 而且在我看来，你理所当然地要为此承担责任。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Which is true.
sentences.zh: 这是事实。

sentences.en: He should be blamed for it.
sentences.zh: 他确实应该为此负责。

sentences.en: And what does he say in response?
sentences.zh: 他对此有什么回应？

sentences.en: He didn't have a good answer.
sentences.zh: 他没有给出好的回答。

sentences.en: He goes back to Homeland Security and there are thousands of criminals crossing the border
sentences.zh: 他总是回到国土安全部的问题上，说有成千上万的罪犯越过边境，

sentences.en: and the border's porous, never once addressing what about these other six bills, which affect important things, food stamps, IRS, FBI, things like that.
sentences.zh: 边境漏洞百出，却从未提及这六项法案，它们影响着食品券、国税局、联邦调查局等重要事务。

sentences.en: I just heard tonight that in a U.S.
sentences.zh: 我今晚刚听说，在一家美国

sentences.en: attorney's office, a young person, 28, 29 years old, but doing cybersecurity, it's not working right now.
sentences.zh: 检察官办公室里，一个28、29岁的年轻人负责网络安全，但现在无法工作了。

sentences.en: Well, that's important stuff.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那可是重要的事情。

sentences.en: Because of the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 因为政府停摆。

sentences.en: Because of the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 因为政府停摆。

sentences.en: But you don't really expect that the president is going to go for what you propose.
sentences.zh: 但你并不真的指望总统会同意你们的提议吧。

sentences.en: So what's the actual plan here?
sentences.zh: 那么实际的计划是什么？

sentences.en: Because you called it a plan.
sentences.zh: 因为你称之为计划。

sentences.en: We don't know if he'll go for it.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他是否会同意。

sentences.en: What are you and Nancy thinking the end game is?
sentences.zh: 你和南希认为最终结果会是什么？

sentences.en: We don't know if he'll go for it initially.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他起初是否会同意。

sentences.en: But if it passes the House, it changes the dynamic.
sentences.zh: 但如果它在众议院通过，情况就会改变。

sentences.en: Because now, you know, the Democrats, particularly the House Democrats, are trying to open up the government.
sentences.zh: 因为现在，你知道，民主党人，特别是众议院的民主党人，正在努力让政府恢复运作。

sentences.en: It puts a lot of pressure, not only on Trump, but on Leader McConnell.
sentences.zh: 这不仅给特朗普，也给麦康奈尔领袖带来了很大压力。

sentences.en: And remember, it's not like last session, where we had all these vulnerable Democrats who were up for re-election.
sentences.zh: 记住，这不像上一届会议，当时我们有许多面临连任压力的脆弱的民主党人。

sentences.en: Now they have a whole bunch of vulnerable Republicans up for re-election.
sentences.zh: 现在他们有一大批面临连任压力的脆弱的共和党人。

sentences.en: And hopefully, people, lots of people will put heat on them and saying, come on, just open up the government.
sentences.zh: 希望人们，很多人能给他们施加压力，说：得了吧，让政府恢复运作吧。

sentences.en: You know, even whatever you think of the wall, you should open up the government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论你怎么看那堵墙，你都应该让政府恢复运作。

sentences.en: So your plan sounds profoundly political, in the sense that you want to put people in the position of having to vote for or against a bill that would fund the government and
sentences.zh: 所以你的计划听起来非常政治化，意思是你想让人们被迫投票支持或反对一项为政府提供资金的法案，

sentences.en: leave them with the political legacy of having said yes or no to that.
sentences.zh: 并让他们承担对该法案投赞成或反对票的政治后果。

sentences.en: Is that the idea?
sentences.zh: 是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: Well, yeah, but it's not political.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，但这并非政治化。

sentences.en: It's substantive.
sentences.zh: 这是实质性的。

sentences.en: I mean, we want to, the government being shut down is a very bad thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们希望……政府停摆是一件非常糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So if you can provide a mechanism by which people have an opportunity to vote to open it back up again because their constituents are being hurt by it and then, of course,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能提供一种机制，让人们有机会投票让政府恢复运作，因为他们的选民正因此受苦，而且当然，

sentences.en: don't like it.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: That's a very good thing.
sentences.zh: 那是一件非常好的事情。

sentences.en: That's how government should work.
sentences.zh: 政府就该这样运作。

sentences.en: But putting forward a plan that Republicans are unlikely to go for is probably not the quickest path to reopening the federal government.
sentences.zh: 但提出一个共和党人不太可能接受的计划，可能不是让联邦政府恢复运作的最快途径。

sentences.en: Well, but when you're dealing with Donald Trump, who changes his position from minute to minute, I've said negotiating with Trump is like negotiating with Jell-O.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但当你面对唐纳德·特朗普时，他每分钟都在改变立场，我说过与特朗普谈判就像与果冻谈判一样。

sentences.en: But the last time we spoke, Senator Schumer, it was one year ago, I believe.
sentences.zh: 但上次我们交谈时，舒默参议员，我想是一年前了。

sentences.en: We were also facing a government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 当时我们也面临政府停摆。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it was again over the border wall.
sentences.zh: 而且又是为了边境墙的问题。

sentences.en: But back then, you were willing, as I recall, to talk about funding the wall in exchange for taking care of the DREAMers.
sentences.zh: 但当时，我记得你愿意谈论以资助边境墙为代价来解决“追梦人”的问题。

sentences.en: Correct me if I'm wrong on any of that.
sentences.zh: 如果我记错了，请纠正我。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what has changed if that would reopen the government?
sentences.zh: 那么如果那样做能让政府恢复运作，现在有什么改变吗？

sentences.en: What changed?
sentences.zh: 什么改变了？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Great question.
sentences.zh: 好问题。

sentences.en: We were willing to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们当时确实愿意那样做。

sentences.en: Why not put it on the table now?
sentences.zh: 为什么现在不把它摆到桌面上呢？

sentences.en: Good question.
sentences.zh: 好问题。

sentences.en: We were willing to do that because we cared so much about the DREAMers.
sentences.zh: 我们当时愿意那样做，是因为我们非常关心“追梦人”。

sentences.en: And the original proposal that Trump initially agreed to was we'll do the full DREAMers for a full wall, right?
sentences.zh: 特朗普最初同意的原始提案是：我们用全面的边境墙换取全面的“追梦人”计划，对吧？

sentences.en: 1.8 million DREAMers all become citizens, not just some half-baked semi-solution.
sentences.zh: 180万“追梦人”全部成为公民，而不是那种半吊子的折中方案。

sentences.en: We agreed.
sentences.zh: 我们同意了。

sentences.en: The same thing that happened this time on the shutdown happened then.
sentences.zh: 这次停摆发生的事情和当时一样。

sentences.en: The right wing beat the daylights out of the president.
sentences.zh: 右翼势力把总统骂得狗血淋头。

sentences.en: Rush Limbaugh, I think, or Coulter or Ingraham called him Amnesty Donald.
sentences.zh: 我想是拉什·林博，或者是库尔特还是英格拉汉姆称他为“特赦唐纳德”。

sentences.en: And he backed off.
sentences.zh: 于是他退缩了。

sentences.en: So our view is that Donald Trump, even if in a room he says, oh, I'll do something for the DREAMers, the minute the right wing beat him up, he would back off.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的观点是，唐纳德·特朗普，即使他在房间里说，哦，我会为“追梦人”做点什么，但只要右翼一攻击他，他就会退缩。

sentences.en: Fooled once, shame on you.
sentences.zh: 被骗一次，那是你的错。

sentences.en: Fooled twice, shame on us.
sentences.zh: 被骗两次，那就是我们的错了。

sentences.en: So you don't trust the president anymore?
sentences.zh: 所以你不再信任总统了吗？

sentences.en: Is that what you're saying?
sentences.zh: 你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: I think he is so afraid of this hard right base.
sentences.zh: 我认为他非常害怕那些极右翼的基本盘。

sentences.en: Look who's giving him advice on this now.
sentences.zh: 看看现在是谁在给他出谋划策。

sentences.en: This fellow Meadows, who's head of the Freedom Caucus.
sentences.zh: 就是这个梅多斯，他是自由党团的负责人。

sentences.en: And that's only 40 of the most right wing.
sentences.zh: 而那仅仅是40个最右翼议员而已。

sentences.en: Yeah, Congressman Meadows from North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 没错，来自北卡罗来纳州的梅多斯众议员。

sentences.en: He's one of 40 of the most right wing congressmen.
sentences.zh: 他是那40位最右翼众议员之一。

sentences.en: They shouldn't be governing America.
sentences.zh: 他们不应该治理美国。

sentences.en: But Trump is letting them do it because he's afraid to lose his base.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普却任由他们胡来，因为他害怕失去自己的基本盘。

sentences.en: He has said, I think publicly, and I know he said it privately, if I lose my base, I have nothing.
sentences.zh: 我想他公开说过，而且我知道他私下也说过，如果我失去了基本盘，我就一无所有了。

sentences.en: But if the president is afraid of the hard right, and there's evidence of that,
sentences.zh: 但如果总统害怕极右翼，而且也有证据表明这一点，

sentences.en: isn't the likelihood that he accepts a Democratic proposal that does not include the wall completely out of the question?
sentences.zh: 那么他接受一项不包含修墙内容的民主党提案，难道不是完全不可能的吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And therefore, aren't we stuck in the cycle of stalemates with no logical end of the shutdown?
sentences.zh: 因此，我们难道不是陷入了僵局的循环，而政府停摆也看不到合乎逻辑的终点吗？

sentences.en: The point with this is, as I said, that Republicans in the Senate will realize that it's hurting them, hurting them, hurting them.
sentences.zh: 问题的关键在于，正如我所说，参议院的共和党人会意识到这正在伤害他们，一次又一次地伤害他们。

sentences.en: And they will say, we want this.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，我们想要解决这个问题。

sentences.en: They will go to McConnell and McConnell will say, look, we've got to make some kind of agreement.
sentences.zh: 他们会去找麦康奈尔，而麦康奈尔会说，听着，我们必须达成某种协议。

sentences.en: And we can make an agreement on all kinds of border security things, but we think a big concrete wall makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在各种边境安全问题上达成协议，但我们认为建一堵巨大的混凝土墙毫无意义。

sentences.en: Do you think that's actually possible that McConnell would do that?
sentences.zh: 你认为麦康奈尔真的会那样做吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's just hard to imagine him embracing the symbolism of the first bill out of a democratically controlled house.
sentences.zh: 很难想象他会接受民主党控制众议院后提出的第一项法案所代表的象征意义。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Him embracing that, sending it to the president.
sentences.zh: 他接受这一点，并将其提交给总统。

sentences.en: So the solution we gave them is not that they have to reject the wall.
sentences.zh: 所以我们给他们的解决方案并不是说他们必须拒绝修墙。

sentences.en: Solution, we said, is open up the rest of the government and let's spend 30 days trying to figure out a solution here.
sentences.zh: 我们说，解决方案是先让政府其余部门恢复运作，让我们花30天时间来想出一个解决办法。

sentences.en: So the Homeland Security bill, we do what's called a CR, reenact last year's bill, for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 所以对于国土安全法案，我们采取所谓的持续决议案，即沿用去年的法案，为期30天。

sentences.en: And during that time, and that's what we said to him at the White House today, said, we're not going to agree on what should be border security today.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里——这也是我们今天在白宫对他说的——我们说，我们今天不会就什么是边境安全达成一致。

sentences.en: But if you went for both these bills, the government would open, but we'd have 30 days to figure out what to do because the Homeland Security bill would only be 30 days.
sentences.zh: 但如果你支持这两项法案，政府就会开门，我们会有30天的时间来决定怎么做，因为国土安全法案的期限只有30天。

sentences.en: We wanted to separate the shutdown of the government from the debate over Homeland Security and the wall.
sentences.zh: 我们想把政府停摆与关于国土安全和修墙的辩论分离开来。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is the wall could actually still be on the table with this plan?
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，在这个计划下，修墙实际上仍然可以摆在桌面上讨论？

sentences.en: For Trump, not for us.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普来说是这样，对我们来说不是。

sentences.en: You know, he's got the military will build the wall, he said at one point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他曾一度说军队会建造这堵墙。

sentences.en: He said he'll get the money from NAFTA to build the wall.
sentences.zh: 他说他会从《北美自由贸易协定》中筹钱来建墙。

sentences.en: At some point, if he realizes he's not getting the wall, there will be ways to figure something out.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，如果他意识到自己拿不到这堵墙，总会有办法解决的。

sentences.en: These are all not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这些都不会发生。

sentences.en: The military is not allowed to build the wall.
sentences.zh: 军队是不允许建造这堵墙的。

sentences.en: NAFTA doesn't give him the money for the wall.
sentences.zh: 《北美自由贸易协定》也不会给他修墙的钱。

sentences.en: But he would say it as a face saving way out to come to this agreement.
sentences.zh: 但他会把它当作一个保全颜面的借口来达成这项协议。

sentences.en: A week later, he could forget all about it or change his mind.
sentences.zh: 一周后，他可能就把这事全忘了，或者改变主意了。

sentences.en: But I have a hard time imagining the president's going to forget about the wall.
sentences.zh: 但我很难想象总统会忘记修墙这件事。

sentences.en: And he hasn't forgotten about it for two years.
sentences.zh: 而且他两年来一直没忘。

sentences.en: And I have a question about this.
sentences.zh: 我对此有个问题。

sentences.en: He said one other thing.
sentences.zh: 他还说了另一件事。

sentences.en: The two I mentioned, the military, he said, or we'll make it an issue in 2020 and win the election on it.
sentences.zh: 我提到的那两点，关于军队，他说，或者我们会在2020年把它作为一个议题，并以此赢得选举。

sentences.en: He will find a face saving way out, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想他会找到一个保全颜面的退路。

sentences.en: And we want to give him the 30 days to figure out what kind of way out he can find.
sentences.zh: 我们想给他30天的时间，让他找出能找到什么样的退路。

sentences.en: From him, it's totally political.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这完全是政治考量。

sentences.en: But is it just a political symbol if it's what got him elected?
sentences.zh: 但如果这正是他当选的原因，那它仅仅是一个政治象征吗？

sentences.en: Or is it the desire of the American people to actually have this?
sentences.zh: 还是说这是美国人民真正想要的？

sentences.en: And if he sees this as a promise he made to voters who elected him, why not just give it to him?
sentences.zh: 如果他认为这是他对选民做出的承诺，为什么不直接满足他呢？

sentences.en: Is there any case, Senator, that this is the will of the people or some meaningful majority of the people and the president is just trying to fulfill a campaign promise?
sentences.zh: 参议员，有没有可能这确实是民意，或者说是相当一部分民众的意愿，而总统只是在履行竞选承诺？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I dispute your premise.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我不同意你的前提。

sentences.en: So why not?
sentences.zh: 那为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right now, the polling shows, while a majority of his base likes it, that's only about a third of the electorate.
sentences.zh: 目前的民调显示，虽然他的基本盘中大多数人喜欢这个主意，但这只占选民的三分之一左右。

sentences.en: The vast majority of Americans are against the wall.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数美国人是反对修墙的。

sentences.en: And what he campaigned on was not the wall, per se.
sentences.zh: 而且他竞选时主打的并不是修墙本身。

sentences.en: It was the wall being paid for by Mexico.
sentences.zh: 而是由墨西哥买单的墙。

sentences.en: And a lot of people said, well, Mexico is paying for it.
sentences.zh: 很多人当时说，好吧，墨西哥会付钱。

sentences.en: What the heck?
sentences.zh: 这算什么？

sentences.en: And there's another question here.
sentences.zh: 这里还有另一个问题。

sentences.en: Do you let a temper tantrum, as I called it, where he bangs the table and says, I'm not going to fund things.
sentences.zh: 你是否会任由一场我称之为“发脾气”的行为发生，他拍着桌子说，我不打算给这些项目拨款。

sentences.en: That's not the way to govern.
sentences.zh: 这不是治理国家的方式。

sentences.en: Then he'll do it on something else and something else and something else through the next few years.
sentences.zh: 然后他在接下来的几年里，会在别的事情上故技重施，一次又一次。

sentences.en: So you said that you don't want to reward what you call the temper tantrum by the president.
sentences.zh: 所以你说过，你不希望奖励总统所谓的“发脾气”行为。

sentences.en: So do you see it as a principled position not to give the president his wall because of the way he's using it as a kind of bludgeon in negotiations?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是否认为不给总统修墙是因为他将其作为谈判中的一种大棒，这是一种原则性立场？

sentences.en: No, my principled position was the wall is very bad.
sentences.zh: 不，我的原则立场是修墙本身就很糟糕。

sentences.en: But there's also the added factor that if you said, why not give in to him?
sentences.zh: 但还有一个附加因素，如果你问，为什么不向他妥协呢？

sentences.en: Aside from it being bad, I think it would encourage him to do it again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 除了它很糟糕之外，我认为这会鼓励他一次又一次地这样做。

sentences.en: I've been wondering, though, if when you're facing a government shutdown, the most principled thing to do is to find a way to reach any resolution.
sentences.zh: 不过我一直在想，当你面临政府停摆时，最讲原则的做法难道不是找到达成任何解决方案的途径吗？

sentences.en: But maybe you're thinking about it a little bit differently.
sentences.zh: 但也许你的想法有点不同。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: I think if we could reach a resolution, it would be great.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果我们能达成解决方案，那将是非常棒的。

sentences.en: But the resolution shouldn't be a 700 mile big, shiny, beautiful, as he says, concrete wall.
sentences.zh: 但解决方案不应该是一堵他所说的700英里长、闪闪发光、漂亮的混凝土墙。

sentences.en: So how do you really think that this ends?
sentences.zh: 那你到底认为这件事会如何收场？

sentences.en: Do you imagine that it ends with Nancy Pelosi and the new House Democrats passing a plan and McConnell and the Senate supporting it?
sentences.zh: 你认为最终会是南希·佩洛西和新上任的民主党众议员通过一项计划，而麦康奈尔和参议院予以支持吗？

sentences.en: I'm not sure they'll do it tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他们明天就会这样做。

sentences.en: But as pressure mounts on them, as it has week to week, I believe that they will then say, let's come to a compromise that we can both agree to.
sentences.zh: 但随着压力像每周那样不断增加，我相信他们最终会说，让我们达成一个双方都能接受的妥协吧。

sentences.en: But it won't contain the wall.
sentences.zh: 但它不会包含修墙的内容。

sentences.en: So when is it that you think this will happen?
sentences.zh: 那你认为这会在什么时候发生？

sentences.en: Well, you know, maybe next week, maybe a little longer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，也许是下周，也许再久一点。

sentences.en: But I think the president's advisers, aside from the hard right ones,
sentences.zh: 但我认为总统的顾问们，除了那些极右翼的之外，

sentences.en: I think that our Republican leadership and our Republican members in the Senate and the House are feeling some real heat.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们的共和党领导层和参众两院的共和党议员们正在感受到真正的压力。

sentences.en: I've been wondering why this shutdown feels different than previous shutdowns, why there seems to be a little less intensity and urgency around it.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，为什么这次停摆感觉与以往不同，为什么围绕它的强度和紧迫感似乎少了一些。

sentences.en: Maybe you would dispute that, but I think it feels different.
sentences.zh: 也许你会反驳这一点，但我认为感觉确实不同。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Three quarters of the government is still open.
sentences.zh: 四分之三的政府部门仍在运作。

sentences.en: I think a lot of it occurred between the Christmas and New Year's break.
sentences.zh: 我认为很大程度上是因为它发生在圣诞节和新年假期之间。

sentences.en: So, A, there were a lot of federal days off and B, people weren't that focused on it.
sentences.zh: 所以，第一，有很多联邦假日，第二，人们并没有那么关注它。

sentences.en: I think the focus is going to increase.
sentences.zh: 我认为关注度会增加。

sentences.en: And number three, because this one is clearly caused by Trump.
sentences.zh: 第三，因为这次停摆显然是由特朗普造成的。

sentences.en: He admitted it in front of the cameras by everybody.
sentences.zh: 他在镜头前当着所有人的面承认了这一点。

sentences.en: And so it has a sort of different feel to it.
sentences.zh: 所以它有一种不同的感觉。

sentences.en: And people say sooner or later, he'll have to back off.
sentences.zh: 人们会说迟早他得退让。

sentences.en: And so Democrats are less concerned about perhaps the optics, the idea of being blamed.
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人对所谓的舆论影响，即被指责的担忧反而减少了。

sentences.en: I mean, he went on and said that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他自己都那样说了。

sentences.en: We want to keep that.
sentences.zh: 我们想保持这一点。

sentences.en: We believe in government.
sentences.zh: 我们相信政府的作用。

sentences.en: We want to keep the government open.
sentences.zh: 我们想让政府保持运作。

sentences.en: I didn't hear you say no to that.
sentences.zh: 我没听到你对此说不。

sentences.en: I mean, the reality that the president having taken responsibility for the shutdown would perhaps not create a ton of incentive for Democrats to therefore end the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，总统承担了停摆的责任，这可能不会给民主党人带来结束停摆的巨大动力。

sentences.en: Well, except look what we offered him today.
sentences.zh: 嗯，看看我们今天给他提供的方案就知道了。

sentences.en: We'd end the three quarters of the government's open now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在就让四分之三的政府部门恢复运作。

sentences.en: Under our proposal, all but 5% of the government would be open tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 根据我们的提案，明天除了5%的政府部门外，其余的都将恢复运作。

sentences.en: So no, that's not true.
sentences.zh: 所以不，那不是真的。

sentences.en: Is it also that divided government is upon us?
sentences.zh: 这也是因为我们正处于分裂政府时期吗？

sentences.en: And so Democrats are better positioned to negotiate and to play hardball and to be more aggressive?
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人更有利于谈判、采取强硬手段并表现得更具侵略性？

sentences.en: No question about it.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: I've said to the president that elections have consequences.
sentences.zh: 我对总统说过，选举是有后果的。

sentences.en: And he is going to have to realize he has two choices.
sentences.zh: 他将不得不意识到他有两个选择。

sentences.en: He can work with us or he can just do what he's doing, which I think is a path to oblivion for him.
sentences.zh: 他可以和我们合作，或者他可以继续做他正在做的事情，我认为那对他来说是一条通往遗忘的道路。

sentences.en: And if you believe, as I do, that he cares most about is his election, re-election, this is a path to oblivion.
sentences.zh: 如果你像我一样相信他最关心的是他的选举和连任，这就是一条通往遗忘的道路。

sentences.en: Now, the $64,000 question, will he realize that?
sentences.zh: 现在，那个价值6.4万美元的问题是，他会意识到这一点吗？

sentences.en: Our hope is that he will.
sentences.zh: 我们希望他会。

sentences.en: So this all sounds very much like you and Speaker-elect Pelosi are preparing to move into this new divided government as a united front.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切听起来很像你和候任议长佩洛西正准备以统一战线的姿态进入这个新的分裂政府。

sentences.en: It's also true that you're about to be in very different positions as of tomorrow, right?
sentences.zh: 同样真实的是，从明天开始，你们将处于非常不同的位置，对吧？

sentences.en: She becomes a majority leader.
sentences.zh: 她成为多数党领袖。

sentences.en: You remain a minority leader.
sentences.zh: 你仍然是少数党领袖。

sentences.en: And with her incoming class comes a much more liberal constituency, I'd argue, than you have.
sentences.zh: 而且随她而来的新成员，我认为比你所代表的选民群体要自由得多。

sentences.en: And it may be very- You mean that in the Senate?
sentences.zh: 这可能非常——你是说在参议院吗？

sentences.en: Than the Senate.
sentences.zh: 比参议院更自由。

sentences.en: Than the Senate.
sentences.zh: 比参议院。

sentences.en: And it's likely to be intent on sending bills to your chamber, to the Senate, that many, perhaps most Democrats in the Senate may not be as comfortable supporting.
sentences.zh: 而且他们很可能会执意向你们参议院提交法案，而参议院中许多，甚至大多数民主党人可能并不乐意支持这些法案。

sentences.en: And that probably have very little chance of passing with McConnell as leader.
sentences.zh: 而且在麦康奈尔担任领袖的情况下，这些法案通过的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: Isn't it inevitable in the coming weeks and months that the two of you are going to have to break from this united front in some important ways?
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周和几个月里，你们两人在某些重要问题上不得不打破这种统一战线，难道不是不可避免的吗？

sentences.en: Let me say two things to that.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，让我说两点。

sentences.en: One, Nancy and I will work together.
sentences.zh: 第一，南希和我将会合作。

sentences.en: And once the bills come over here, there'll be two choices.
sentences.zh: 一旦法案送到这边，会有两个选择。

sentences.en: And it will be unified, she and I.
sentences.zh: 我和她将保持统一。

sentences.en: Whether we can get McConnell to compromise enough so that we can pass some of these bills, even if it doesn't have everything we like.
sentences.zh: 我们能否让麦康奈尔做出足够的妥协，以便我们能通过其中一些法案，即使它没有包含我们喜欢的所有内容。

sentences.en: And I'm not going to do that on my own, I'm only going to do that with Nancy's okay, because if we change it and send it back to the House,
sentences.zh: 我不会独自做决定，我只会征得南希的同意，因为如果我们修改了它并把它送回众议院，

sentences.en: what good is it if the House Democrats won't pass it, right?
sentences.zh: 如果众议院民主党人不通过它，那又有什么用呢，对吧？

sentences.en: Or we will put pressure on these more vulnerable Republican senators, because the world has flipped a little bit in the Senate,
sentences.zh: 或者我们会向那些更脆弱的共和党参议员施压，因为参议院的世界已经发生了一点变化，

sentences.en: where there are far more vulnerable Republicans up in 2020 than Democrats.
sentences.zh: 在2020年面临改选的共和党人远比民主党人脆弱得多。

sentences.en: And we'll put pressure on them to help support these bills, you know, infrastructure, things like that.
sentences.zh: 我们会向他们施压，让他们支持这些法案，你知道，基础设施建设之类的项目。

sentences.en: So I think that'll work.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这会奏效。

sentences.en: But the second thing, and this is about the Senate, we've had enormous unity in our Senate.
sentences.zh: 但第二点，这是关于参议院的，我们在参议院拥有巨大的团结。

sentences.en: That's how we defeated health care.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们如何击败医保法案的方式。

sentences.en: That's how we got these two budgets done in the past and even got three quarters of this one done.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们过去完成这两项预算，甚至完成了这一个预算的四分之三的方式。

sentences.en: I have a leadership group that meets every Monday of 10 people, now 11.
sentences.zh: 我有一个由10人，现在是11人组成的领导小组，每周一开会。

sentences.en: You know who's on it?
sentences.zh: 你知道谁在里面吗？

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders, Joe Manchin, Mark Warner.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦、伯尼·桑德斯、乔·曼钦、马克·华纳。

sentences.en: It spans the breadth, the wide breadth of our democratic ideology.
sentences.zh: 它涵盖了我们民主党意识形态的广度，非常广泛的广度。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we work together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起工作。

sentences.en: What I've tried to do as democratic leaders have everyone talk to each other, everyone understand everyone else's positions, and it's created tremendous unity.
sentences.zh: 作为民主党领袖，我尝试做的是让每个人都互相交谈，让每个人都理解对方的立场，这创造了巨大的团结。

sentences.en: I don't expect that unity to fade.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这种团结会消失。

sentences.en: It's going to be even stronger because it was so successful for us.
sentences.zh: 它会变得更加强大，因为这对我们来说非常成功。

sentences.en: Is the point you're trying to make that you're trying to create space inside the Democratic Party for all types of democratic belief, all types of policy?
sentences.zh: 你想要表达的观点是，你正试图在民主党内部为各种民主信仰和各种政策创造空间吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, but one point I'd make clear, I believe that Donald Trump is hurting, screwing working families, poorer people, black, white, Hispanic, Asian.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我得明确一点，我认为唐纳德·特朗普正在伤害、坑害工薪家庭，无论是穷人、黑人、白人、拉美裔还是亚裔。

sentences.en: And I believe we have to take very strong medicine against the kinds of things he's doing.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信，对于他所做的那些事情，我们必须采取强有力的应对措施。

sentences.en: And you think that's what should unite the Democratic Party?
sentences.zh: 你认为这就是应该团结民主党的原因吗？

sentences.en: And that I think can unite our Democratic Party in a very, very strong way.
sentences.zh: 我认为这能以一种非常、非常有力的方式团结我们的民主党。

sentences.en: But are you afraid of what Democrats might do in the House now that they have this power?
sentences.zh: 但你是否担心民主党人现在掌握了众议院权力后会做出什么举动？

sentences.en: Are you worried they might overstep that things like investigating the president, talk of impeachment, could jeopardize the party heading into 2020?
sentences.zh: 你是否担心他们可能会越界，比如调查总统、谈论弹劾，从而危及党派在2020年的前景？

sentences.en: You know, let me tell you, I think the kind of energy that we are seeing in the country for some real change is very real and not just limited to, quote, the left wing.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，让我告诉你，我认为我们在全国范围内看到的对真正变革的渴望是非常真实的，绝不仅仅局限于所谓的“左翼”。

sentences.en: So I think it's going to work out quite well.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为一切都会进展得相当顺利。

sentences.en: What about the freshman class of Democrats?
sentences.zh: 那新当选的民主党议员们呢？

sentences.en: We've met many of them.
sentences.zh: 我们已经见过他们中的许多人了。

sentences.en: They are activist legislators.
sentences.zh: 他们是积极进取的立法者。

sentences.en: They are liberal to the bone.
sentences.zh: 他们骨子里就是自由派。

sentences.en: You think that Pelosi will be able to keep some of the more left wing elements of her chamber from going too far?
sentences.zh: 你认为佩洛西能够阻止她所在党团中一些更偏左的成员走得太远吗？

sentences.en: I think the lesson that we took in the Senate in the last two years, where we were a very diverse group, is when we're unified,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在过去两年参议院的经历中吸取的教训是，当我们团结一致时——我们是一个非常多元化的群体——

sentences.en: we're far more effective at moving the country forward, at proffering our ideas, and in preventing Donald Trump from doing bad things.
sentences.zh: 我们在推动国家前进、提出我们的想法以及阻止唐纳德·特朗普做坏事方面要有效得多。

sentences.en: That happened almost organically.
sentences.zh: 那是自然而然发生的。

sentences.en: And I think it'll happen in the House.
sentences.zh: 我认为在众议院也会如此。

sentences.en: I'm interested just more generally in how you're thinking about governing in this era of divided Washington now.
sentences.zh: 我更感兴趣的是，你如何看待在如今华盛顿分裂的时代进行治理？

sentences.en: Should we expect Washington to become even less effective than it is now, with the House passing bills that have no shot at moving forward in the Senate,
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该预料到华盛顿会变得比现在更低效，因为众议院通过的法案在参议院根本没有通过的机会，

sentences.en: or being signed by the president?
sentences.zh: 或者根本不会被总统签署？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, you know, even with the Republicans in control, aside from judges and the tax bill, they didn't get very much done.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，即使在共和党掌控时期，除了法官任命和税改法案，他们也没干成多少事。

sentences.en: But I am not pessimistic.
sentences.zh: 但我并不悲观。

sentences.en: I am optimistic that we can do a few things.
sentences.zh: 我乐观地认为我们可以做成几件事。

sentences.en: One is really create a much clearer image in people's minds of what we believe and where we think America ought to go.
sentences.zh: 第一，真正让人们更清晰地认识到我们的信仰以及我们认为美国应该走向何方。

sentences.en: I think there will be times when we will be able to get some things done.
sentences.zh: 我认为会有一些时候我们能够完成一些事情。

sentences.en: And I think that it may well be that we force some of the more mainstream Republicans to break more frequently with Donald Trump than they have in the last two years.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我们很可能会迫使一些更主流的共和党人比过去两年更频繁地与唐纳德·特朗普决裂。

sentences.en: Have they indicated to you that that's on the table?
sentences.zh: 他们是否向你暗示过这种可能性？

sentences.en: A few have.
sentences.zh: 有几个人暗示过。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: We'll see more.
sentences.zh: 我们会看到更多这种情况。

sentences.en: Look, to be honest with you, I'm friendly with a bunch of the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 听着，老实说，我和很多共和党人私交不错。

sentences.en: The things they say privately about Donald Trump are so much worse than the things they say publicly.
sentences.zh: 他们私下里对唐纳德·特朗普的评价比公开场合说的要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: But with a Democratic House, with the country moving in our direction, with the election results as they are,
sentences.zh: 但随着民主党掌控众议院，随着国家朝着我们的方向发展，随着选举结果的呈现，

sentences.en: maybe some more of that private feeling will bubble up to the public in terms of their actions.
sentences.zh: 也许会有更多这种私下的感受在他们的行动中显露出来。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: You think this idea that Donald Trump controls Washington, kind of keeps a lid on things, might be less real and less dominant in the next two years?
sentences.zh: 你认为“唐纳德·特朗普控制着华盛顿，压制着一切”这种观点，在未来两年可能会变得不那么真实、不那么占主导地位吗？

sentences.en: Control is too strong a word.
sentences.zh: “控制”这个词太重了。

sentences.en: He doesn't really control.
sentences.zh: 他并没有真正控制。

sentences.en: He dominates the news cycles.
sentences.zh: 他只是主导了新闻周期。

sentences.en: But, you know, the first meeting that Nancy and I had with him is sort of a metaphor for what's going to happen in the next two years.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，南希和我与他的第一次会面，某种程度上就是未来两年将会发生什么的缩影。

sentences.en: One of the Republican staffers said this is the first time he's heard things that he doesn't want to hear.
sentences.zh: 一位共和党幕僚说，这是他第一次听到他不想听的话。

sentences.en: He's going to hear a lot more of that in the next few years.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，他会听到更多这样的话。

sentences.en: I mean, that dynamic you're describing, do you think that's the reason why President Trump allowed the shutdown to move into the new year?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你描述的那种动态，你认为这就是特朗普总统允许政府停摆持续到新年的原因吗？

sentences.en: Is it because he was counseled that it was better to be seen as having this fight with Democrats now that they are in control,
sentences.zh: 是因为有人建议他，现在民主党掌权了，与他们进行这场斗争，

sentences.en: especially with Nancy Pelosi as a symbol, than with the old guard, with the Paul Ryans?
sentences.zh: 尤其是以南希·佩洛西作为象征，要比面对旧势力（比如保罗·瑞安）看起来更好？

sentences.en: And is that what this is going to now look like?
sentences.zh: 这就是未来局势的样子吗？

sentences.en: No, I think the shutdown is Trump's need to prove to his hard right base that he will stand for the number one thing he promised them.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为政府停摆是因为特朗普需要向他的极右翼基本盘证明，他会坚持他承诺给他们的头等大事。

sentences.en: Well, Senator, thank you very much for your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，参议员，非常感谢您抽出时间。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Great to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: You have managed to create a truly warm fire, which I am sweating from.
sentences.zh: 你成功生起了一团真正的暖火，烤得我都在出汗了。

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 给你。

sentences.en: There you go.
sentences.zh: 给你。

sentences.en: Look at that.
sentences.zh: 看那个。

sentences.en: I didn't flip it.
sentences.zh: 我没翻面。

sentences.en: You kept me so busy.
sentences.zh: 你让我太忙了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In a series of tweets on Wednesday night, President Trump seemed to hold out hope of an agreement, writing, quote,
sentences.zh: 在周三晚间的一系列推文中，特朗普总统似乎对达成协议抱有希望，他写道，引用如下：

sentences.en: I remain ready and willing to work with Democrats to pass a bill that secures our borders, supports the agents and officers on the ground and keeps America safe.
sentences.zh: “我随时准备并愿意与民主党人合作，通过一项能够确保我们边境安全、支持一线特工和官员并保障美国安全的法案。”

sentences.en: Let's get it done.
sentences.zh: 让我们把它完成吧。

sentences.en: But even before he met with Schumer and Pelosi on Wednesday, the president rejected a compromise suggested by his own vice president, Mike Pence,
sentences.zh: 但在周三与舒默和佩洛西会面之前，总统就拒绝了他自己的副总统迈克·彭斯提出的妥协方案，

sentences.en: that would provide about half the money he requested for the border wall,
sentences.zh: 该方案提供的资金约为他所要求的边境墙预算的一半，

sentences.en: as well as a proposal from Republican senators Lamar Alexander and Lindsey Graham that would revisit the idea of funding the wall in exchange for protection for the dreamers.
sentences.zh: 以及共和党参议员拉马尔·亚历山大和林赛·格雷厄姆提出的建议，即重新考虑以“为梦想者提供保护”来换取边境墙资金的想法。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间跨越付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的事情。

sentences.en: Beginning at noon, the incoming class of Democrats in the House will be sworn into office inside the Capitol as they take control of the chamber for the first time since 2010.
sentences.zh: 从中午开始，新一届民主党众议员将在国会大厦宣誓就职，这是他们自2010年以来首次掌控众议院。

sentences.en: Representative Nancy Pelosi is also expected to reclaim her former title as Speaker of the House, becoming the first lawmaker in more than half a century to hold the office twice.
sentences.zh: 众议员南希·佩洛西也有望重掌众议院议长头衔，成为半个多世纪以来第一位两度担任该职位的立法者。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, Pelosi issued a statement to Democrats about the legislation she intends to bring forward today to reopen agencies now closed by the shutdown,
sentences.zh: 周二晚间，佩洛西向民主党人发表声明，谈到了她打算在今天提出的立法，旨在重新开放因政府停摆而关闭的机构，

sentences.en: but not to fund the border wall.
sentences.zh: 但不包括为边境墙提供资金。

sentences.en: We are giving the Republicans the opportunity to take yes for an answer, she said of the bills.
sentences.zh: “我们正在给共和党人一个接受的机会，”她在谈到这些法案时说。

sentences.en: If they reject it now, they will be fully complicit in chaos and destruction of the president's third shutdown of his trial.
sentences.zh: “如果他们现在拒绝，他们将完全成为总统任期内第三次政府停摆所带来的混乱和破坏的同谋。”

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人激动的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
